name: The Brood of Onyxia
summary: In the marsh's south, Draz'Zilb sends you against Onyxia's eggs. No more of her whelps should hatch.

sections.title: The Eggs in the Wyrmbog
sections.body: Onyxia's brood lies scattered through the Dragonmurk. Draz'Zilb urges you south to the Wyrmbog, where the ogre is sure Onyxia made her lair and scattered her eggs. Dragons nest in the land around Stonemaul Village, keeping the ogres from taking it back. So you are sent to find and destroy the eggs.

sections.title: One Last Service
sections.body: When the eggs are destroyed, Draz'Zilb says Onyxia will need some time before she can lay more. The ogre thanks you on behalf of the Stonemaul Clan. Then Draz'Zilb asks one last service. Mok'Morokk is unfit to lead, but Tharg, who would make an excellent leader, is held back by injuries and age. Drive Mok'Morokk out by force, and a new leader can bring the clan back to its proper home in the south.

aliases: who gives the brood of onyxia
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village sends you to destroy Onyxia's eggs.

faq.q: Why must the dragon eggs be destroyed?
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb wants no more of Onyxia's whelps to hatch. While dragons nest in the land around Stonemaul Village, the ogres cannot take it back.
The eggs are around the Wyrmbog in the marsh's south. Draz'Zilb is sure Onyxia made her lair there.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the broader chain?
aliases: what comes before brood of onyxia 3
faq.answer: This follows Mok'Morokk's refusal to act on news of the brood. You carried his answer back to Draz'Zilb.
